title: No Proof Of YouTube Split: Fans speculate about Dalton and Sako; arrest claims stay unverified

Additionally, unverified reports of an arrest in West Virginia from February have emerged, though no verified details are available. Despite this, their joint videos continue to showcase a united front as a married couple.
